_comment: The world is the oracle's, in two halves. Every SUGAR key is absent, because
rules.md line 115 says a missing key takes the oracle's command-line default,
and for sugar those defaults already equal what reference/dtl-python/config.json
ships: a 50x50 lattice, 250 settlers, maxSugar 4, regrow 1, and two mountains
at (15,35) and (35,15). Restating them could only drift.
The five SPICE keys below are present because the command-line defaults zero
them (maxSpice 0, regrow 0, metabolism [0,0]) while the shipped config.json the
reference is documented to run — 'python sugarscape.py --conf config.json' —
does not. Sugar and spice are the game; a settler has two metabolisms and must
hold both to live. Every value here is copied from that file, unchanged.
This tiles the plate: 1.2% of cells are bare against 27.6% with sugar alone. An
earlier revision read that as the mountains being gone and switched spice off to
get bare ground back. It is not — the massifs are still there as HEIGHT, cells
ramping 1 to 4 around each of the four peaks, and the board draws that height as
grain density. Bare ground is not what makes a mountain legible here.
Two keys stay at the command-line default rather than config.json: timesteps
(200, not 1000 — episode length is a Coworld call) and agentMaxAge ([-1,-1], no
aging deaths). This is a variant of the reference world, not a restatement of it.
